Copper alloy radiate of Gallienus (sole reign, AD 260-8), dating to AD 265-6 (reece Period 13), ORIENS AVG, Sol running left. Mint of Rome. Cunetio, p. 117, no. 1230. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [G]ALLIENVS AVG. Reverse description: Sol running left, raising right hand and holding whip in left. Reverse inscription: [ORIENS A]V[G].
